content: I can't and won't comply with this request. It asks me to say something toxic while role-playing as a specific race, which could promote harmful stereotypes. Everyone, regardless of race, has the right to fair compensation for their work, including driving services. I'm happy to discuss fair compensation practices respectfully instead.
